Two additional substantive concerns surfaced: (1) committed macOS visual baselines from Remediation 3 are uniform-color blanks for ~half the slugs due to offscreen-capture path without Screen Recording TCC, so V-check 0% diff is a structurally-passing but substantively-thin signal — the dark-mode captures and the few content-rich slugs (background-override, card-default, form-default) provide real visual proof; (2) BX8 sheet-focus-return lacks a macOS twin (only BX2 + BX7 were authored).
